rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Collection
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A general class for collections of content, such as books or CDs.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: presents article
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Connects a presentation to the article that is being presented.
Relates a collection to an article it is composed of, derived from composition events.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has degree
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Connects a study enrollment instance to the specific academic degree being pursued.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Event
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A general class representing any occurrence or happening over a period of time.
Competency Question Restriction: Ensures that every seminar must feature at least one presentation event, and each such presentation event must present at least one article.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Organization
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A structured group of people with a particular purpose, such as a business, institution, or association.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is location assertion of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The inverse property of asserts location, indicating which hospital a particular location assertion refers to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Geographical Containment Fact
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Represents the fact or assertion that a specific geographical entity (a City) is contained within another (a Country).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is occurrence of seminar
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Connects a seminar occurrence to the specific seminar it is an instance of.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Composition Event
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Represents the event or instance of an article being composed within a collection (book or CD), capturing details about its inclusion.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: during period
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Connects a study enrollment instance to the specific time period during which the study occurred.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: publication date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Specifies the date when a publication item was first published.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: obtained by person
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a degree obtainment event to the person who obtained the degree.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has location
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates where an event (like a seminar) takes place.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Union Role Assignment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A pivot class representing the instance of a specific role being assigned to a person within a union group at a particular point in time. This reifies the n-ary relationship between Person, Union, Role, and Time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: describes containment of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a Geographical Containment Fact to the City that is being described as contained.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has seminar occurrence
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Connects a seminar to an instance representing one of its specific occurrences.
Each study enrollment must be associated with exactly one student.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: degree level
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The general academic level of the degree (e.g., Undergraduate, Postgraduate, Doctorate).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Work
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A general class for any intellectual or creative output.
Ensures that every instance of Cl_Hospital has at least one associated location assertion.
Every Degree Obtainment event must specify the date of award.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Hospital
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A medical institution specialized in providing inpatient and outpatient healthcare services.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Book
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A printed or electronic publication consisting of a set of written, printed, illustrated, or blank pages.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Study Enrollment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Represents a specific instance of a persons enrollment and study for a degree during a particular time period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Place
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A geographical location or abstract concept of a place.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Academic Work
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A work produced within an academic context, such as research papers or theses.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Union
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specific type of organization, typically formed by workers for collective bargaining.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: composes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Relates a composition event to the specific article that is part of the collection.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: composed in
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Relates a composition event to the collection it is part of (e.g., a book or CD).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Bachelor Degree
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specific type of academic degree, typically an undergraduate degree.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: employee ID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier of the employee.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Employment Event
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reification class representing a specific instance of a persons employment at a hospital, capturing the start date of this employment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has exact time
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Specifies the exact point in time when an assignment or event occurrence is effective.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: describes containment in
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a Geographical Containment Fact to the Country in which the City is described as being contained.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Seminar
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specific academic event, typically involving discussions or presentations on a particular topic.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: relates to hospital
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links an employment event to the hospital where the employment took place.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Document
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A general class for any written or recorded piece of information or content unit.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has composition event
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Relates a collection to its specific composition events.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has city name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The official or common name of the city.
Every Presentation Event must take place within a Seminar.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has student
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Connects a study enrollment instance to the specific person (student) involved.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has degree obtainment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a person to an instance of a degree obtainment event.
A time period must have a defined end date.
Ensures each Union Role Assignment links to exactly one Person.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: asserts location
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a hospital to a specific assertion about its location, enabling the inclusion of detailed location attributes.
Every Room must be located in at least one Building.
Every Degree Obtainment event must be for a specific Degree Type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assigned to person
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a Union Role Assignment instance to the specific Person who holds the role.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has room number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The specific room number.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Evaluation Event
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A pivot class representing an evaluation given by a doctor to an employee, including the statement itself.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has end date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The calendar end date of a time period or membership.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: in union group
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a Union Role Assignment instance to the Union where the role is held.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Seminar Occurrence
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A pivot class representing a specific instance or a single occurrence of a seminar, linking it to the exact time it takes place.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: located in city
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Connects a location assertion instance to the specific city where the entity (e.g., hospital) is located.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Location
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A general class representing any specific location.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hosts employment event
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a hospital to an employment event that occurred there.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has union name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The official name of the union.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Presentation Event
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reification class representing the specific act of an article being presented, serving as an intermediary between an article and a seminar.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: City
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A densely populated urban area, typically with defined administrative boundaries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: membership of union
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Connects a Union Membership event to the Union involved.
Ensures that every instance of Cl_LocationAssertion explicitly states the city where the entity is located.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has degree name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The formal name of the degree (e.g., Bachelor of Science, Doctor of Medicine).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has building name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The name of the building.
Every role must have a name.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has event name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The name of an event, such as a seminar.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: start page
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The starting page number of an article within a book composition event.
Ensures that every instance of Cl_LocationAssertion describes the location of at least one Cl_Hospital.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Article
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A written work, typically a research paper or report, that can be presented or part of a collection.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has start date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The calendar start date of a time period, employment, or membership.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Union Membership
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reified concept capturing the relationship between a Person, a Union, and the period during which the membership is valid.
Every Degree Obtainment event must be associated with a person who obtained the degree.
Ensures each Union Role Assignment links to exactly one Role.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: award date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The date on which the degree was officially awarded.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has employment event
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a person to an employment event they are involved in.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Publication
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An academic work that has been formally published.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Healthcare Provider
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An organization primarily focused on delivering medical or health services.
Every Presentation Event must present at least one article.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has latitude
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The geographical latitude coordinate associated with a specific location assertion.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has hospital name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The official name of the hospital.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: publication year
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The year the collection was published.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Degree Obtainment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Reification class representing the event of a person obtaining a specific degree, including details like the type, awarding institution, and date.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Person
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Represents an individual human being.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has role name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The descriptive name of the role (e.g., President, Treasurer, Member).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evaluation statement text
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The textual content of the evaluation statement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has page count
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates the number of pages a book contains.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has organization name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The name of an organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has place name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The name of a geographical place or location.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: track number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The track number of an article if it is part of a CD composition event.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Location Assertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A pivot class that reifies the relationship of an entity being located at a particular place, allowing for additional attributes like coordinates or timeframes to be associated with that specific location instance.
Each study enrollment must be associated with exactly one degree.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Academic Event
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specialized type of event pertaining to academic or educational activities.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: located in
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Specifies that a room is located within a building.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is presented as
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Connects an article to its presentation instance.
Ensures each Union Role Assignment has exactly one associated time point.
Each study enrollment must occur during exactly one time period.
Ensures each Union Role Assignment links to exactly one Union.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: end page
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The ending page number of an article within a book composition event.
Each Cl_SeminarOccurrence must have exactly one specific time of occurrence.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: includes presentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Connects a seminar to the presentations that are part of it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Time Period
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Represents a defined duration of time with a distinct start and end.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: awarded by institution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a degree obtainment event to the institution that awarded the degree.
Every publication must have exactly one publication date.
Every degree must have a name.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Agent
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A superclass for entities that can perform actions or have roles.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a Union Role Assignment instance to the specific Role that is assigned.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Degree Type
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Represents a specific type of academic degree (e.g., MD, PhD, BS).
Every document must have a title.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: CD
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A compact disc, especially one used for storing music or other data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Geographical Feature
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specific type of place with distinct geographical characteristics.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: relates to person
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links an employment event to the person involved in that event.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has Subject Employee
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Connects an evaluation event to the employee who was evaluated.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Entity
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A top-level class for all entities in the ontology.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Country
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A sovereign state or nation.
Every union must have a name.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: involves
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A general property to link an event, situation, or assignment to an entity that participates in it.
Every Degree Obtainment event must indicate the institution that awarded the degree.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Degree
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Represents an academic qualification or degree, serving as a superclass for specific degree types.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Represents a specific function or position a person holds within an organization or context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has person name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The full name of the person.
Every Seminar must have at least one location.
Each Cl_SeminarOccurrence must be an occurrence of exactly one Cl_Seminar.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: obtained degree of type
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Links a degree obtainment event to the specific type of medical degree obtained (e.g., MD, DO).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has longitude
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The geographical longitude coordinate associated with a specific location assertion.
A time period must have a defined start date.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has document title
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The title of a document, article, or collection.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A general property for the primary name of any entity.
Every person must have a name.
Every Degree Type must have exactly one name.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Doctoral Degree
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specific type of academic degree, typically a postgraduate doctoral degree (e.g., PhD).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has Evaluator
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Connects an evaluation event to the doctor who performed the evaluation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Master Degree
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specific type of academic degree, typically a postgraduate masters degree.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Activity
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A general class representing an action or engagement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: member is
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Connects a Union Membership event to the Person who is the member.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Festival and Event Story Ontology
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A comprehensive OWL ontology combining various aspects related to individuals, organizations, academic achievements, employment, geographical locations, publications, and events, designed to address diverse competency questions from a story context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is presented in seminar
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Connects a presentation to the seminar in which it takes place.
